theme: An open day with one anchor at 1.
greeting: Good morning, Dan. The day is nearly all yours — only the NACD program at 1 breaks it up, which leaves the morning a clean stretch for the holiday bookings that have been sitting on the board.

needsAttention.title: Hold the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: On the Mike + Dan board since mid-September and still open. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market, the Pathfinder has gone south, and a refundable hold booked now costs nothing and removes the whole risk.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December break
needsAttention.detail: Both the decide-by and book-by dates have passed. The Dec 13 to Jan 2 trip is six people over the holidays on the thinnest inventory of the year, so settling on a domestic shortlist and booking this week is the safe play.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, receipts, an Amex offer, and a couple of shipping updates.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is waiting on a reply.
